$comment: What a product can be assembled from. Plain data: a planner reads it without running any code here. Every tracked file has exactly one home below (a test enforces it); scripts/assemble.mjs builds a product tree from it, and its tests keep the lists true. A starter's project.json app entry is not repeated here: `app` names the entry in project.json, which stays the one place it is written.

engine.description: The loop: verify, review, isolate, deploy, smoke, triage. Every product has all of it, synced from the base for good; a file is only here when this list names it or the directory above it.

seeded.description: Copied into a product once, then the product's own: it differs per repository and an agent may not edit it.

generated.description: Written fresh for each product, never copied: the base's own copy describes the base. `.github/dependabot.yml` is the one file taken out of the engine's `.github` directory: it is the base's own file cut down to the ecosystems the product has.

base.description: Belongs to the base repository alone and never reaches a product, including the files that test or build the parts.

python-fastapi.description: A Python API on FastAPI with security headers and a /health endpoint, tested with pytest and linted with ruff.

node-react.description: An Ionic React web app on Vite, with a Playwright end-to-end suite and a documentation site built into its bundle at /docs/.

vercel.description: Deploys an app to Vercel: the build-skip step, the freshness smoke gate and preview pruning ship with the engine; `npm run deploy:add` copies the template files in once.
